FX-TURB-AE-001.says: Units after_effects, amount 80, size 2, speed 0, tutorial 2's setting: the push is 80 x 2 / 100 = 1.6 pixels at most, so every pixel reads from within two pixels of itself and the stripes stay stripes, shimmering.

FX-TURB-AE-002.says: The same settings in a file without units: D-127's rule as before, a push of up to 80 pixels at a wave every two, so each pixel reads from far off, mostly past the drawing: it breaks into dust, and in this small frame only two specks are left.

FX-TURB-AE-004.says: Units after_effects with the settings as they start, amount 10, size 60, speed 20: the push is 6 pixels at most, D-127's amount 6, size 60, on every frame.

FX-TURB-AE-005.says: Units after_effects, amount 3, size 1000, speed 0: past size 100 the push is the amount, so this is FX-TURB-009 exactly.

FX-TURB-AE-006.says: Units after_effects, amount 3, size 100, speed 0: at size 100 the push is the amount, D-127's amount 3, size 100.

FX-TURB-AE-007.says: Units after_effects, amount 30, size 8, speed 0: a push of 2.4 pixels at most, D-127's amount 2.4 at size 8; the layer grows by 3.

FX-TURB-AE-008.says: Units after_effects, size 8, speed 0, amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 40 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 amount 20 (a push of 1.6), frame 4 amount 40 (3.2).

FX-TURB-AE-009.says: FX-TURB-AE-001 with edges repeat: nothing grows, and a push past the drawing's edge reads the nearest edge pixel.

FX-TURB-AE-010.says: FX-TURB-AE-007 with seed 8, moved three pixels right: the layer grows by ceil(2.4) = 3, so the three columns left of the drawing show the stripes pushed into them.

FX-TURB-AE-011.says: Units "After_Effects": the word is exact, so capitals are not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURB-AE-012.says: Units "ae", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
